python3 - << 'PY'
import json, re
from pathlib import Path

files = [
"25f52fa5-49a1-4a87-9854-00eaf785d592",
"db65345a-4027-4aed-a48e-b9fdf8920b79",
]
base=Path("/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts")
for name in files:
    fp=base/name/f"{name}.jsonl"
    print("\n##########", name)
    lines=list(open(fp))
    o=json.loads(lines[0])
    c=o["message"]["content"]
    if isinstance(c, list):
        text="\n".join(x.get("text","") if isinstance(x, dict) else str(x) for x in c)
    else:
        text=c
    # find user_query and also later sections that look like actual task
    for m in re.finditer(r"<user_query>\s*(.*?)\s*</user_query>", text, re.S):
        print("USER_QUERY:\n", m.group(1)[:2000])
    # also print last 1500 of user message if no query
    if "<user_query>" not in text:
        print("TAIL USER:\n", text[-1500:])
    # last assistant text
    last=json.loads(lines[-1])
    mc=last["message"]["content"]
    if isinstance(mc, list):
        at="\n".join((x.get("text") or "") if isinstance(x, dict) else str(x) for x in mc)
    else:
        at=str(mc)
    print("\n--- LAST ASSISTANT (tail 1800) ---\n", at[-1800:])
PY
